messages:
maria_cs: Heads up — Meridian seat for reserved pool goes live next Tue. Need final quota plan, autoscale thresholds, and a load test window. Renewal flagged as at-risk if we miss p95 latency target (<=300ms). Who can own what?

ashley_platform: I can own autoscale + batching suggestions. Need expected steady-state QPS and average tokens per request from their integration team.

devin_oncall: I’ll run the stress harness. Prefer Wed 08:00 PT for smoke then full soak. Will need allowlist for our test runners and a short maintenance window entry.

sam_csm: FYI CS flagged the renewal as high attention — doing an enablement call Thu AM with their infra lead. If the load test shows regressions we should be ready with mitigation steps (credits / extra runbook).

ryan_sre: Can we avoid the previous 2x-uncontrolled surge behavior? Proposal: staged autoscale policy — immediate step to 1.5x, cooldown 120s, then additional steps up to 3x; model fallback enabled only after sustained >5m of overload. Draft policy below: 

```
{ "policy_name": "meridian-staged-autoscale",
  "steps": [
    {"scale": 1.5, "trigger": "p95_tokens_per_sec > 200"},
    {"scale": 2.0, "trigger": "p95_tokens_per_sec > 350", "cooldown_s": 120},
    {"scale": 3.0, "trigger": "sustained(p95_lat>300, 300)"}
  ],
  "model_fallback": {"enabled": true, "delay_s": 300, "fallback_model": "smaller-quantized"}
}
```

ops_bot: ops-bot: loadtest job created: job/meridian-stress at 2025-06-18T15:00Z — artifacts will go to /shared/meridian-loadtests. Allowlist: 10.8.0.0/22 and runners: load-r1..r4.

ashley_platform: Also recommend a KV cache warmup before spike tests: `cache-prime --account meridian --duration 15m` to avoid cold-cache variance in p95.

devin_oncall: Test plan I’ll follow: smoke 15m -> soak 2h -> 3x spike tests 15m each with 10m recovery. I’ll abort if p95 > 300ms for >5m and post immediate logs to /shared/meridian-loadtests/current.

maria_cs: Good. Sam — if we abort we need the renewal mitigation checklist ready: 1) immediate enablement session 2) token credit for the next billing month 3) follow-up PoC with tuned batching. Can you draft the customer-facing checklist?

sam_csm: On it. I’ll draft the email + checklist and share in this thread. Also will capture any qualitative feedback from their infra team during enablement.

ryan_sre: One more technical ask: disable cross-region fallback for the tenant during the test so we isolate latency sources. @ops_bot can you set `fallback_scope: local` for meridian?

ops_bot: ops-bot: updated routing config prodops:meridian/route_policy -> `fallback_scope: local`. Change applied to staging and will rollout to prod at 2025-06-17T02:00Z.

ashley_platform: Autoscale policy pushed to staging: https://console.redwood.dev/staging/policies/meridian-autoscale — I’ve attached the batch size recommendation in the policy notes.

devin_oncall: Copy. I’ll collect perf counters (inflight queue, token-ms) and upload CSVs. If we see queuing > 80% of buffer for >3m, we stop and rollback to canary.

maria_cs: If we abort we trigger renewal play: 1) emergency enablement call within 48h 2) 1-month credit option 3) tailored follow-up run with an SRE + Platform engineer. Sam will handle the comms.

sam_csm: :thumbsup: I’ll prepare the comms and the customer checklist doc.

ryan_sre: +1 — I’ll be on the enablement call for technical deep-dive.

maria_cs: Thanks team. Quick sync Wed 09:00 PT (pre-test) to walk the plan and roles. Calendar invite sent. Agenda: run order, abort conditions, escalation path, customer comms.

ashley_platform: Leaving a note here — add the traffic shaping rule: `max_burst = 1.2 * expected_peak` to reduce overshoot.

devin_oncall: Noted. I’ll include shaping in the harness.

maria_cs: Closing loop: ops_bot, confirm allowlist and job schedule in this thread once final.

ops_bot: ops-bot: allowlist verified and job scheduled. Job URL: https://ops.redwood/job/meridian-stress/1755001111. Artifacts will be present after run.

maria_cs: Perfect. I’ll post the postmortem template and renewal playbook after the soak.

sam_csm: Will collect qualitative feedback and add to renewal playbook.

ryan_sre: Good plan. See you Wed.
